questions.q:
$$\text{Let } S_i \text{ denote the set of all integers n such that } 100i\leq n \lt 100(i+1). \\ 
\text{For example } S_4 \text{ contains } 400,401, 402, 403,...,499. \\\text{ How many such sets from } S_0 \text{ to } S_{999} \text{ do not contain a perfect square.}$$
questions.a: $$\text{There are }\textbf{708} \text{ such sets that do not contain a perfect square.}$$

questions.q:
$$\text{How many positive perfect squares less than } 10^6 \text{ are multiples of 24}?.
\\
\text{(A perfect square is an integer that is the square of an integer)}$$

$$\text{Determine the number of positive integral values of p for which there exists a } \\
\text{ triangle with sides a, b and c satisfying } a^2+(p^2+9)b^2+9c^2-6ab-6pcb=0.$$
questions.a: $$\text{ There are 5 such positive integral values. } p\in(6,12)$$

questions.q:
$$\text{Given that } A=\frac{\sin6^{\circ}}{\cos18^\circ} \quad B =\frac{\sin12^{\circ}}{\cos36^\circ} \quad C=\frac{\sin18^{\circ}}{\cos54^\circ} \text{ and }P=\tan18^\circ\cos12^\circ-\sin12^\circ \quad Q=\tan36^\circ\cos24^\circ-\sin24^\circ
\\ 
\quad R=\tan54^\circ\cos36^\circ+\sin36^\circ \text{ then find the value of }\\
\\
N=\left( \frac{A}{P}+\frac{B}{Q}+\left\lfloor \frac{C}{R} \right\rfloor \right)^2+\left\lfloor \frac{A}{P}+\frac{B}{Q}+\left\lfloor \frac{C}{R} \right\rfloor \right\rfloor$$

$$\text{If } \cos^2\left[\frac{\pi}{4}(\sin x + \sqrt{2}\cos^2 x)\right] - \tan^2\left(x + \frac{\pi}{4}\tan^2 x\right) = 1 \\\text{ then find the value of }
\sin(x).$$
$$\text{If } \frac{\tan70^\circ\tan10^\circ+3}{\tan70^\circ+\tan10^\circ}=\tan x \text{ and x is acute, } \\ \text{then find x.}$$

questions.q:
$$\text{If } 2\log_x7+\log_{7x}7_+3\log_{49x}7=0 \text{ has two solutions } \alpha \text{ and } \beta \text{ then find } \alpha^{\frac{-3}{4}}+\beta^{-2} \\ \text{ such that both } 
\alpha^{\frac{-3}{4}},\beta^{-2}\in \mathbb{Z}^{+}.$$

$$\text{Let } f(x) \text{ a quadratic polynomial with leading coeffient 1 such that } f(0)=p \text{ and } p\neq0. \\
f(1)=\frac{1}{3}. \text{ If equation } f(x)=0 \text{ and } f\circ f\circ f\circ f(x)=0 \text{ have a common root then find } f(-3)$$
$$\text{If } \bigg| 2-\left| x-2026 \right| \bigg|<2 \text{ has the solution } x\in(a,b)\text{ and } x\neq c \text{ then find } \left( \frac{c+4}{2030} \right)\cdot a \,+8$$

$$P(x)=x^6-x^5-x^3-x^2-x \quad Q(x)=x^4-x^3-x^2-1. \text{ If } \alpha,\beta,\gamma\text{ and }\delta \text{ be the roots of } \\
Q(x)=0, \text{ then find } P(\alpha)+P(\beta)+P(\gamma)+P(\delta)$$
$$\text{Find the solution set of }\frac{\bigg(\prod_{r=1}^{100}(x-r)^r\bigg)\sin(\frac{\pi x}{100})}{\log_e(x^2-100x+901)}\geq0; \quad x\in[0,100]$$
$$\text{ If }\sum_{k=1}^{N}\frac{2k+1}{(k^2+k)^2}=0.9999, \text{ then find the value of N.}$$
$$\text{Find the number of ordered pairs }(x, y)\text{, where both }\\ x\text{ and }y\text{ are integers between }-100\text{ and }100\text{ inclusive, such that } \\ 12x^2 - xy - 6y^2 = 0.$$

$$\text{Consider a quadratic equation } x^2-4x-n=0\\
 \text{ where } n\in\mathbb{N} \text{ and } n\in[10,200]. \\
\text{ Find the total number of possible values of n that give the equation integer roots.}$$
